name: cameri-schematics
description: The authoring plugin for agentic schematics. This repository's schematic catalog is a separate file, .agent-schematics/marketplace.json, and is not a plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: schematics
plugins.description: The authoring plugin — authors, reverse-engineers, and maintains agentic schematics: self-contained build specifications anyone can implement independently, without central coordination. Provides the create-schematic, build-schematic and audit-schematic skills.
